ex.en: Hurry up. We're about to pass that car up ahead.
ex.zh: 快點，我們馬上就要超過前面那輛車了。

ex.en: Go ahead to the end of the street.
ex.zh: 一直往前走到這條街的盡頭。

ex.en: Please inform me of the plan ahead of time.
We finished the project two weeks ahead of schedule.
ex.zh: 我們比預定提早兩週完成了專案。

ex.en: The weather forecast predicts a sunny week ahead.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說接下來一週都是晴天。

ex.en: We have a busy month ahead.
ex.zh: 接下來我們有忙碌的一個月。

ex.en: Skip the problems you can not do and go ahead.
ex.zh: 跳過不會做的題目，繼續往下做。

ex.en: Go ahead and start without me.
